title: Question 16
passage:
I thought they canceled all the swim lessons. Why are you packing a towel?
A. Only the outdoor class was canceled. B. The blue towel is still damp. C. The changing room has two benches.
passageZh:
我以為他們把所有游泳課都取消了。你怎麼還在準備毛巾？
A. 只有戶外班取消了。 B. 藍色毛巾還有點濕。 C. 更衣室有兩張長椅。
